summary_en: 400,000 shares (20.65% of S/O ex-treasury) up to ¥1.0B. 立会外 (off-exchange) method. Execution window Jul 17–29, 2026. Purchase price and date to be announced before each trading day. Primary shareholder Kaameiji Co. confirmed to supply shares for this block.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and treasury share off-exchange purchase transactions
translation_en_brief: On 15 July 2026, Q-Papanets (Fukuoka Stock Exchange, Q-Board) announced a treasury share block purchase programme. The company will acquire up to 400,000 common shares (20.65% of 1,937,200 shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for an aggregate consideration up to ¥1.0 billion. Execution occurs via 立会外 (off-exchange) transaction on the Fukuoka Stock Exchange between 17 and 29 July 2026. On each trading day during this window, the company will place a buy order on the previous day's close price (inclusive of last quote), to be executed the following morning at 8:50 a.m., valid for that trading session only. Specific purchase dates and prices will be disclosed by 5 p.m. Fukuoka time on the day before each execution. The primary shareholder and major investor, Kaameiji Co., has confirmed it will supply shares for this block. The company states the purpose is to enhance capital efficiency and corporate value, and to conduct responsive capital policy amid changing business conditions. Results will be disclosed immediately after each trading session concludes.
